## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check:ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behaviour
- [ ] New API routes are registered in `src/lib/server/route-policies.ts`
- [ ] Database changes include a migration and keep the full-text index in sync
- [ ] User-visible changes are noted under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Deviations from the specification are recorded in `docs/project/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] No real personal data in code, tests, screenshots or fixtures
